verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not show any published per-GPU-hour price list. The quoted text from paperspace.com/pricing is only Gradient marketing and a free-account prompt, and the GPU cloud page gives only a vague "save up to 70%" claim. One user's mention of a standard GPU VM's hourly rate and another's mention of the $9/mo Pro tier do not show a public per-GPU-type price table available without contacting sales.
